description: This file is a code-behind for an ASP.NET Web Forms page (`ShowAns.aspx`) that displays students' answers and allows submitting marks for specific questions. It interacts directly with a SQL database to retrieve and update data related to student answers and marks.

classes.name: ShowAns
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ShowAns.aspx page, handling page load, answer display, and mark submission.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial loading of the page. Retrieves student answers for questions 1 to 5 from the database and displays them in corresponding UI controls.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Redirects the user to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Redirects the user to the AdminQueue page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates total marks, updates the database with the new marks, removes student from the course queue, and transfers to the course queue page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs the user out and redirects to the login page.
